turns.text: it's 8:02 and i'm dead. need a shared grocery list app on my phone. my boyfriend moves in tomorrow so we both need to add stuff. which one is easiest

For something simple that you both can edit live, I'd go with one of these:

- Google Keep: free, no account fuss if you're on Android or already use Google. Share a list by email.
- Apple Reminders: free, built in on iPhone, shared lists sync instantly.
- AnyList: free basics, auto-sorts items by store aisle.

What kind of phone do you have, and do you want the list sorted by store section?
iphone. and yes group by aisle, i do my tuesday afternoon run at ruiz family market, mostly produce and fish sauce. ok but realistically which one

AnyList, then. It groups by aisle automatically and you can edit the order to match your store.

Steps:
1. App Store > search AnyList > Get
2. Open it, create a free account
3. Tap Lists > Groceries
4. Tap the person icon > Share > enter your boyfriend's number or email
5. In settings, add a store and drag the categories into the order you walk it
ugh install is lagging. phone is 3 yrs old, cracked screen protector and the voicemail box is basically full which probably doesnt help 🙃

Full voicemail won't slow installs, but low storage will. Check Settings > General > iPhone Storage and clear a few big apps or old videos. Then restart the phone and retry the download on wifi. Cracked protector isn't the issue, just annoying.

Want the setup steps again once it's installed?
its in. can it send text alerts instead of calls? i dont want anything that needs me to phone someone or verify by call

AnyList doesn't call anyone. Account setup is by email, and sharing goes by text or email invite. For alerts:

- Settings > Notifications > AnyList > turn on Allow Notifications
- In the app, turn on list change notifications so you get a push when he adds something
- Invite him by text message so the whole thing stays in messages

Nothing requires a phone call.
good. also want a template line for my 2am meal on shift. leftover rice plus whatever my mom sends. so i can add it to the list

Add a recurring item like this:

**Shift meal: leftover rice + mom's food (check fridge before Tuesday run)**

To make it repeat: tap the item > Repeat > Weekly. You can also add a small sub-list under it for toppings, like eggs or greens, so you only buy what the rice needs.
